annotations.title: Work on the question and criteria

description: Use this when preparing stage 1 and the eligibility criteria. action check: AI quality check of the question of a review that already exists (framework, missing parts, better wording; new reviews are checked by create). action suggest_pico: AI breakdown into concepts (saved only if there is none yet; prefer it when the breakdown is empty and AI is available). action set_pico: save the breakdown the researcher confirmed in the chat, no AI (concepts of the framework; omitted fields stay, an empty string clears one). Only with values the researcher confirmed: show them and ask first, never invent. Use it to fix or complete concepts, or when AI is not available; refused once stage 1 is approved. Then call revisia_approve_stage. action suggest_criteria: AI draft of criteria, runs as a job; read the result with revisia_question. action set_criteria: save criteria the researcher accepts (add, or edit by id) or apply a preset pack. No exclusion type: write each criterion as a condition eligible studies meet; exclusion_label is the shown exclusion reason. action remove_criterion: delete by criterion_id. Once the review is screened, ask the researcher why BEFORE calling either and pass it as reason (reported as a protocol amendment); both report the criteria version, what the change needs and the affected records. action rescreen: screen affected records again with the current criteria (dry_run default; then revisia_jobs). AI actions count against the account's AI limits exactly as in the web app; an unconfirmed email gets a few trial calls.

concepts.description: set_pico: concept fields of the framework, only values the researcher confirmed. Omitted = unchanged; "" = cleared.

criteria.description: set_criteria: criteria to add (no id) or edit (with id).

id.description: Existing criterion id to edit; leave out to add a new one.

stage.description: abstract = title/abstract screening; fulltext = full-text screening.

dry_run.description: Default true: only report what would run and the quota used. false launches.

framework.description: set_pico: question framework; leave out to keep the saved one.

idempotency_key.description: Same key within 24 h returns the first launch instead of a second job.

partial_ack.description: rescreen: researcher agreed to a partial run.

preset.description: set_criteria: apply one of revisia's preset criteria packs instead.

reason.description: Why the researcher changes criteria after screening; ask before the call.
